description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.8-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed Linux keep-alive flooding logs and wasting CPU
- Fixed first song cutting out after long idle on Linux
- Fixed repeated VLC warnings flooding logs
- Fixed rescans losing songs added from outside music folders
- Fixed files added during a library scan getting lost
- Fixed untagged files in Downloads showing username as artist
- Fixed dropped folders playing in the wrong order
- Fixed drag overlay flickering and refusing drops
- Fixed Lyrics Studio freezing the window when starting a run
- Fixed Lyrics Studio Stop throwing away your review
- Fixed Lyrics Studio finished songs stealing focus while editing
- Fixed saved songs reopening with the wrong lyrics
- Fixed Lyrics Studio model downloads fighting each other
- Fixed Lyrics Studio progress jumping backwards
- Fixed typed lyrics being lost when leaving the page
- Fixed ELRC words spilling past their line
- Fixed Lyrics Studio detecting the wrong song language
- Fixed artist name cutting off letters that dip below the line
- Fixed genre label being cropped
Added
- Added smarter search with multi-field matching
- Added search tags for artist, album, title, genre, composer and year
- Added year ranges in search
- Added quoted phrases in search
- Added search syntax tooltip
- Added Newest Albums First toggle for Album Artist sort
- Added drop zones for playing, queueing, adding to library and new playlists
- Added dropping files onto sidebar playlists
- Added Lullaby lyrics model
- Added Lyrics Studio download card with speed, time left and pause
- Added per-song and batch progress in Lyrics Studio
- Added model download checksums
Improved
- Improved Lyrics Studio line timing accuracy
- Improved timing of words Whisper misses
- Improved Lyrics Studio model size
- Improved drop zone visibility and animation
- Improved Remove from Library dialog text
- Improved playlist header wording
- Improved genre label readability
Full Changelog: v1.5.7...v1.5.8
